title: trace PURL enrichment manifest
description: A reviewable mapping from nixpkgs attr_path to one or more Package URLs. nixpkgs does not carry PURL metadata natively, so trace maintains this manifest as a SEPARATE, auditable enrichment layer. The graph builder merges entries into snapshot nodes at extract time and records provenance in snapshot.enrichment.purl_mappings_applied — Scout consumes flat purls[] at the node level but the audit trail stays with the snapshot. Deliberately: no inline patching of nixpkgs package expressions. Never-authoritative: Steward does not treat an enriched PURL as different from any other, and Scout records it the same way through the normal purl-exact path.

value.description: A PURL string. The token `{version}` (literal) is substituted at extract time with the node's extracted version, so manifest entries stay valid across nixpkgs rev bumps. Non-template values pass through verbatim.
